title: Technical Challenges
use_cases: Configure when working with base models that require zero or few-shot implicit guidance
Implement when developing high-level narrative structures that must span multiple context windows
Use when designing dynamic example selection systems for runtime prompt optimization
Configure when managing memory constraints in long-sequence autoregressive generation tasks
content:
The primary challenges remain:

Implicit Prompting with Base Models: Since I’m using base models without fine-tuning, I need to create carefully crafted few-shot examples that implicitly guide the model toward proper generation at each layer.

Few-Shot Selection System: Developing an LLM-based understanding of each example’s impact on generation, requiring a separate perception system to analyze and select optimal examples at runtime.

Sequential Thinking: Working with the inherently sequential nature of autoregressive transformers while maintaining hierarchical narrative coherence across long-form text.

Context Window Management: Exploring whether we can truncate older sequence elements while preserving just terminal elements with sufficient context markers, implement some form of compression for historical elements, or employ a hybrid approach. This becomes critical when generating long-form narratives that exceed model context limits.
